authority_basis: G2 §10: novelty may open review but can never vote for transformation; data-quality defects reverse the claim

rules.rationale: an interesting apparent contradiction opens WATCH — investigation, not transformation
early evidence is legitimately escalated for ADVERSE review
data-quality defect parks escalation; the anomaly is preserved, not erased
apparent contradiction collapses under inspection; no structural change
institution returns to STABLE; the failed claim is demoted, not erased
